coverage_notes: Section 10.3 states a consequence of breach: the licensee is not entitled to rely on the License’s terms or complain of a Licensor breach. It does not prohibit or condition a listed activity, and the fixed activity vocabulary has no faithful action for relying on contractual terms or making a complaint.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 10.3 makes loss of entitlement to rely on the License or complain of a Licensor breach a consequence of the licensee’s breach. Neither contractual reliance nor complaining fits a listed activity; representing it as a restriction on Use would misstate the rule.
